findings.title: Symlink escape allowed when follow_symlinks=True in url_for

When `self._follow_symlinks` is True the subsequent `filepath.relative_to(self._directory)` check is skipped, allowing a symlink inside the static directory to point outside and be served. filepath.relative_to(self._directory)  # enforce for all cases

Removing these breaks backward compatibility for callers that rely on the flag or catch the exception. Add deprecation warnings and retain the parameters (or provide a compatibility shim) to avoid breaking existing code.

findings.title: Unsafe protocol options no longer validated
findings.explanation: The previous implementation rejected clone operations that used unsafe protocols or config options unless the caller set `unsafe_protocols=True`. The recent change removes this validation, allowing URLs like `ext::` or `--config protocol.xxx` to be used unchecked, which can lead to arbitrary command execution. Re‑introduce the validation (or a safer alternative) and raise an appropriate exception when unsafe options are detected.
